status_reason: The envelope, durable transport, routing and sequencing composition are reached from production and tested; MeshTransport and PubSubTransport are real, tested implementations that no app or runtime code currently constructs, and the one production journal construction site is always in-memory rather than the file-backed ::open variant the type also offers.
